in_hebrew.name: Hurlbut
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Hurlbut הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Old English 'here' (meaning 'army, warriors') and 'buta' (meaning 'strong, fortified place'). This name represents a strong and protective figure.

in_greek.name: Hurlbut
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Strong fortress
in_greek.long_meaning: Hurlbut είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from Old English 'here' (meaning 'army, warriors') and 'buta' (meaning 'strong, fortified place'). This name represents a strong and protective figure.

in_latin.name: Hurlbut
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Strong fortress
in_latin.long_meaning: Hurlbut est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from Old English 'here' (meaning 'army, warriors') and 'buta' (meaning 'strong, fortified place'). This name represents a strong and protective figure.
